newsitem.title: USA: Geon sees Q3 EPS below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Geon sees Q3 EPS below expectations.

text.p: The Geon Co said Wednesday it expected third-quarter earnings to fall short of expectations.
The company said it expected earnings to be between $0.10 to $0.20 less than second-quarter earnings of $0.40 per share.

The company said it was lowering its estimates because of a decline in cash margins in polyvinyl chloride (PVC) resins despite strong demand. It also cited recent problems in manufacturing vinyl chloride monomer (VCM).
The company also said a planned July 1 price increase was not implemented, and chlorine and ethylene costs increased during the third quarter.
The company said its newly expanded VCM plant in LaPorte, Texas, has experienced problems with new equipment, limiting production, increasing costs and requiring higher-than-planned purchases of VCM.
